import re


def top_words(text, n):
    words = re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', text.lower())
    counts = Counter(words)
    sorted_items = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))
    return [w for w, _ in sorted_items[:n]]

from collections import Counter
import re


def top_words(text, n):
    words = re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', text.lower())
    counts = Counter(words)
    sorted_items = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))
    return [w for w, _ in sorted_items[:n]]
```
